overview.zh: 本周AI建设者们在X上的发言涵盖了从模型安全到用户体验的多个方面，展示了AI技术的最新进展和挑战。讨论的重点包括提高AI系统的安全性、优化用户与AI交互的方式以及构建更有效的开发流程。
overview.en: This week, AI builders on X covered a wide range of topics from model security to user experience, showcasing the latest advancements and challenges in AI technology. The discussions highlighted improving AI system security, optimizing user interactions with AI, and building more effective development workflows.

summary.zh: 多位发言者强调了提高AI系统安全性的重要性，特别是在对抗恶意攻击和确保用户数据隐私方面。Boris Cherny提到Anthropic已经解决了Claude模型中的提示注入问题，而Thariq则介绍了Claude生成文本的嵌入式水印功能。
summary.en: Several speakers emphasized the importance of enhancing AI system security, particularly against malicious attacks and ensuring user data privacy. Boris Cherny mentioned that Anthropic has largely solved the prompt injection issue in Claude models, while Thariq introduced embedded watermarking for Claude-generated text.

quotes.author: Boris Cherny
quotes.text: At Anthropic we have been training our models not to fall for these kinds of attacks, and the results have been surprisingly positive. We have largely solved the threat of prompt injection in practice when using Claude models.

quotes.author: Thariq
quotes.text: All Claude generated text will have this embedded watermarking. For example, you could check if a PR was generated by Claude Code. That said, it does have limitations.

summary.zh: 改善用户体验是本周讨论的一个重要主题。Peter Yang分享了如何通过语音控制云代理来改变我们使用计算机的方式，而Zara Zhang则提供了一种利用Codex分析网站设计的方法。
summary.en: Improving user experience was a key topic this week. Peter Yang shared how voice control of cloud agents can change the way we use computers, while Zara Zhang provided a method for using Codex to analyze website design.

quotes.author: Peter Yang
quotes.text: We’re moving from doing work manually with a keyboard, mouse, and laptop to directing agents in the cloud using our voices. In my new essay, I cover why: 1. Voice is becoming the orchestration layer 2. Personal computers will move to the cloud 3. Trust will be the key differentiator

quotes.author: Zara Zhang
quotes.text: A great way to learn design: Give Codex a well-designed website, ask it to analyze what makes the design great, then ask it to take a complete screenshot of the website & add annotations on the image that breaks down why the design works

summary.zh: 几位发言者讨论了如何优化开发流程以提高效率。Swyx提出了删除不必要的技能以减少上下文负担的建议，而Guillermo Rauch则强调了代码审查的重要性。
summary.en: Several speakers discussed optimizing development workflows for increased efficiency. Swyx suggested deleting unnecessary skills to reduce context burden, while Guillermo Rauch emphasized the importance of code review.

quotes.author: Swyx
quotes.text: occasional reminder to DELETE your skills. when you are bombarded constantly by 'this skill changed my life!! you have to try!!' on the timeline, you will pile up stuff that at best just eats context, and at worst interacts with other skills nastily in unforeseen ways if you dont stare at your traces.

quotes.author: Guillermo Rauch
quotes.text: “Did you deepsec it?” “@𝚟 can you deepsec” “/𝚍𝚎𝚎𝚙𝚜𝚎𝚌” It’s a bit like /𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛𝚖𝚘-𝚗𝚞𝚌𝚕𝚎𝚊𝚛-𝚌𝚘𝚍𝚎-𝚚𝚞𝚊𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢-𝚛𝚎𝚟𝚒𝚎𝚠 but for the security of your code. Must have in your software factory.
